name: bugfix_alacrity_ap
description: Two-layer semantic fix for Alacrity. Layer 1: the TurnNumber==0 guard in the check chain is always false (turn numbering starts at 1); bypass it by redirecting the AND1 input to the CurrentPlayer guard. Layer 2: BUFF_Plus1AP_1Turn lacks TurnsLeft, so OnBuffAdded and OnBuffRemoved cancel out and AP never increases; insert TurnsLeft=1 with a variable-length edit to match related buffs.
source: Clean Steam baseline, Build 1837603 (edited in place; no assets from refs/PC_EE are referenced).
grading: L0: Layer 1 equal-length single-byte edit with dual assertions and diff verification; Layer 2 byte-for-byte assertions on names, imports, existing properties, and remaining export data, with an unchanged decode_bp function list (uasset_mutate.verify_insert passed). L2 cold boot / L3 in-game not verified.
install_note: First package to mix variable-length and equal-length edits. If loading fails with a fatal error, restore the whole package from the baseline backup.

detail.what: AND1 first input prop5 -> 3 (bypasses the TurnNumber guard, keeps 0.25)
Insert TurnsLeft=1 into the CDO (IntProperty, variable-length, +42 bytes)
